text:
Anya: quick heads-up — I pushed a first-pass RICE for the Q3 inference prioritization doc, link: https://redwood/repo/q3-rice :eyes:
Devin: saw it, thanks. quick Q — for 'Reach' I leaned into # of customer teams affected vs org-wide features. is that the right axis?
Anya: yes, reach = active teams impacted in next 6 months. happy to adjust if we want weighted by revenue.
Max: +1 to keeping reach team-count first. operationally, Dedicated capacity changes will need eng-infra + infra-sre coordination. can't ship simultaneously with the scheduled cluster resize in week 5.
Maria: can we make that a hard dependency in the spec? if eng-infra is blocked we should defer noncritical UX work.
Devin: that matters for scoring 'Effort' too — if we need cross-team resourcing it bumps effort 2->4.
Sam: FYI oncall is light in July but crunchy in late Aug (cf. team PTO). if a feature needs an SRE lead, prefer launch before 8/20.
Anya: good call. I'll add an explicit launch window constraint and tie to rollout plan.
Max: suggestion: split into 2 sub-PRs — core routing + telemetry. ship routing first (lower risk), telemetry as follow-up. reduces cross-team overlap.
Devin: agreed. routing = minimal schema changes, we can canary within 2 weeks. telemetry needs product events from mobile which is a separate dependency.
Anya: new plan then: mark telemetry as 'post-launch' with a medium impact bump; routing gets priority.
Maria: also add `launch_criteria: no P0 regressions on latency, canary < 5% error rate, infra sign-off` to the doc. makes rollout gating explicit.
Devin: for RICE calc I adjusted Reach=6, Impact=3 (internal dev velocity), Confidence=0.8, Effort=3 -> score ~ 48.
Max: sounds reasonable if we enforce sequencing. otherwise effort goes up and score drops.
product-bot: checklist created: [spec attached], assigned: @Anya, reviewers: @Devin @Max, due: 1790009000.
Anya: I'll update the spec with the dependency map and a 2-week spike card for telemetry. expecting a follow-up PR by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Sam: can someone flag this in the eng-oncall calendar once dates are firm? I'll reserve SRE support for canary.
Devin: will do. tagging this as `prio:high` in the roadmap board.
Max: if we need extra hands for the spike, suggest pulling a backend IC from platform for 2w. I can ping leads.
Anya: thanks — let's avoid scope creep: core routing must be MVP. telemetry optional for launch.
Maria: ok, locking scope and adding the RICE table snippet to the top of the doc for reviewers.
Devin: LGTM. next step: Anya updates doc, then 24h of async review. :rocket:
